feedback.answered: In a clean copy the harness reported: recovery_seed with seed_lb_ballot -1, record_vbal_reported_by_self 3 and instance_vbal_after_seed 3 (so the self PrepareReply announces the newly made ballot, not the record's old vbal, and self_status is NONE); reply_delivered with prepare_replies 2 after the peer's real PrepareReply was pushed through the real wire form; and resolution with lb_status 1 (PREACCEPTED), instance_status 1 (PREACCEPTED), instance_cmds_len 1 with first op 0 (NOOP), adopted_committed_vector false, preaccept_sent true and out_codes starting with the PreAccept code 11. The final event records remote_status 4 (COMMITTED), instance_status_after 1 and command_after 0. So the mechanism is reproduced end to end on the trusted runner: a recovering replica holding only a default record ignores a PrepareReply that reports the instance COMMITTED at an older vbal and restarts phase 1 with NOOP, while the sender's own VBallot equals the new ballot and the leader bookkeeping was seeded with the old vbal.
